channel.title: AI RSS Feeds News
channel.description: Announcements about the AI RSS Feeds collection: feeds added, removed, broken and fixed.

item.title: Added AI RSS Feeds News
item.description: This feed. Subscribe to it to hear when feeds in the collection are added, removed, broken or fixed. It mirrors the News section of the README and is included in feeds.opml.

item.title: Added Claude News, deprecated Claude Blog
item.description: claude.com/blog now redirects to claude.com/resources/articles, so the Claude Blog feed has been replaced by a new Claude News feed (feeds/claude-news.xml). The old feeds/claude-blog.xml remains but will no longer be updated, so switch your subscription to the new feed.

item.title: Three feeds broken
item.description: The Turing Blog, CETaS Research and CETaS Analysis feeds are broken and not currently updating.

item.title: Three new feeds
item.description: Added feeds for CETaS Analysis (feeds/cetas-analysis.xml) and CETaS Research (feeds/cetas-research.xml) from the Alan Turing Institute's Centre for Emerging Technology and Security, and for the Cosine Blog (feeds/cosine-blog.xml).

item.title: Added SpaceX AI News
item.description: Added a feed for SpaceX AI News from x.ai/news (feeds/spacex-ai-news.xml).

item.title: Fixed Turing Blog
item.description: The Turing Blog feed (feeds/turing-blog.xml) is working and updating again.

item.title: The Batch broken
item.description: The Batch feed (feeds/the-batch.xml) is broken and not currently updating.

item.title: Turing Blog broken
item.description: The Turing Blog feed (feeds/turing-blog.xml) is broken and not currently updating.

item.title: Added Cohere Blog and Mistral News
item.description: Added feeds for the Cohere Blog (feeds/cohere-blog.xml) and Mistral News (feeds/mistral-news.xml).

item.title: Initial release
item.description: First release of AI RSS Feeds, with feeds for AISI Blog, Ai2 News, Anthropic News, Anthropic Research, Claude Blog, The Batch, Mila News, Turing Blog, Turing News and TLDR AI.
